title: HSK 1.6 · 老师, 手机, 飞机, 再见, 告诉
focus: 几 · 见 · 手 · 非常 · 叫 · 请 · 钱 · 本 · 东西 · 三 · 买 · 问 · 告诉 · 老 · 男人 · 男 · 飞 · 老师 · 病 · 手机 · 看见 · 西 · 常 · 飞机 · 病人 · 生日 · 东 · 家人 · 最好 · 见面 · 好看 · 机场 · 老人 · 工人 · 在家 · 好吃 · 再见 · 常常 · 男生
body:
People and things around you: 老, 男 and 人 build words for people, 机 (machine) shows up in 手机, 飞机 and 机场, and 见 forms greetings and "see" words.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 人 | rén | person | 男人, 病人, 家人, 老人, 工人 |
| 见 | jiàn | see | 看见, 见面, 再见 |
| 机 | jī | machine (木 + 几) | 手机, 飞机, 机场 |
| 老 | lǎo | old | 老师, 老人 |
| 男 | nán | male (田 + 力) | 男人, 男生 |
| 好 | hǎo | good | 最好, 好看, 好吃 |
| 常 | cháng | often, usual | 非常, 常常 |
| 手 / 飞 / 病 | shǒu / fēi / bìng | hand / fly / ill | 手机, 飞机, 病人 |

## Watch out

- 几 (jǐ) vs 九 (jiǔ, nine) vs 儿 (ér).
- 见 (jiàn, see) vs 贝 (bèi, shell): 见's last stroke curls out.
- 西 (xī) vs 四 (sì, four): 西 has a stroke across the top.
- 东 (dōng, east) vs 车 (chē, vehicle).

cards.Example: 你有几个孩子? nǐ yǒu jǐ ge háizi: How many kids do you have?
cards.Notes: Picture of a small table. 几 vs 九 (jiǔ, nine) vs 儿 (ér)

cards.Example: 明天见! míngtiān jiàn: See you tomorrow!
cards.Notes: Simplified from 見: a big eye 目 on legs 儿. 见 vs 贝 (bèi, shell)

cards.Example: 请洗手。 qǐng xǐ shǒu: Please wash your hands.
cards.Notes: Picture of a hand with fingers; as a radical it becomes 扌

cards.Example: 我非常喜欢。 wǒ fēicháng xǐhuan: I really like it.
cards.Notes: 非 not + 常 usual = unusual, so 'extremely'

cards.Example: 妈妈叫你。 māma jiào nǐ: Mom's calling you.
cards.Notes: 口 mouth on the left: things you do with your voice

cards.Example: 请喝水。 qǐng hē shuǐ: Please have some water.
cards.Notes: 讠 speech + 青 qīng: polite words

cards.Example: 我有钱了! wǒ yǒu qián le: I've got money now!
cards.Notes: 钅 metal (coins) + 戋 on the right

cards.Example: 我买了一本书。 wǒ mǎi le yì běn shū: I bought a book.
cards.Notes: 木 tree + a line marking the root. 本 vs 木 vs 末 (mò, tip)

cards.Example: 这是我的东西。 zhè shì wǒ de dōngxi: That's my stuff.
cards.Notes: Literally east + west; read dōngxī it means 'east and west'

cards.Example: 我有三个哥哥。 wǒ yǒu sān ge gēge: I have three older brothers.
cards.Notes: Three lines = three

cards.Example: 妈妈去买菜了。 māma qù mǎi cài le: Mom went to buy groceries.
cards.Notes: 买 vs 卖 (mài, sell): 卖 has an extra 十 on top

cards.Example: 我问你一个问题。 wǒ wèn nǐ yí ge wèntí: Let me ask you something.
cards.Notes: 门 mén (door, also the sound) + 口 mouth: a mouth at the door, asking

cards.Example: 别告诉他。 bié gàosu tā: Don't tell him.
cards.Notes: 告 announce (牛 + 口) + 诉 tell (讠 speech) = to tell

cards.Example: 我老了。 wǒ lǎo le: I'm getting old.
cards.Notes: Picture of an old person bent with a cane. Before surnames it's friendly: 老王

cards.Example: 那个男人是谁? nàge nánrén shì shéi: Who's that man?
cards.Notes: 男 male + 人 person

cards.Example: 他是男的。 tā shì nán de: He's male.
cards.Notes: 田 field + 力 strength: the one who works the field

cards.Example: 鸟在飞。 niǎo zài fēi: The bird is flying.
cards.Notes: Simplified from 飛, a picture of wings; just 3 strokes

cards.Example: 老师好! lǎoshī hǎo: Hello, teacher!
cards.Notes: 老 old, respected + 师 master = teacher

cards.Example: 他病了。 tā bìng le: He's sick.
cards.Notes: 疒 sickness radical + 丙 bǐng for the sound

cards.Example: 我的手机呢? wǒ de shǒujī ne: Where's my phone?
cards.Notes: 手 hand + 机 machine = handheld machine

cards.Example: 你看见我的猫了吗? nǐ kànjiàn wǒ de māo le ma: Did you see my cat?
cards.Notes: 看 look + 见 see = look and actually see

cards.Example: 太阳在西边。 tàiyáng zài xībian: The sun is in the west.
cards.Notes: Originally a picture of a bird's nest, borrowed for 'west'. 西 vs 四 (sì)

cards.Example: 他常来。 tā cháng lái: He comes often.
cards.Notes: 尚 shàng (top, for the sound) + 巾 cloth

cards.Example: 我坐飞机去。 wǒ zuò fēijī qù: I'm flying there.
cards.Notes: 飞 fly + 机 machine = flying machine

cards.Example: 病人在睡觉。 bìngrén zài shuìjiào: The patient is sleeping.
cards.Notes: 病 ill + 人 person

cards.Example: 生日快乐! shēngrì kuàilè: Happy birthday!
cards.Notes: 生 born + 日 day = birthday

cards.Example: 我住在东边。 wǒ zhù zài dōngbian: I live on the east side.
cards.Notes: Simplified from 東 (looks like 日 sun behind 木 tree). 东 vs 车 (chē)

cards.Example: 我很想家人。 wǒ hěn xiǎng jiārén: I miss my family.
cards.Notes: 家 home + 人 person = family

cards.Example: 你最好别去。 nǐ zuìhǎo bié qù: You'd better not go.
cards.Notes: 最 most + 好 good = best, so 'you'd best...'

cards.Example: 我们明天见面吧。 wǒmen míngtiān jiànmiàn ba: Let's meet tomorrow.
cards.Notes: 见 see + 面 face = see face to face

cards.Example: 这个电影很好看。 zhège diànyǐng hěn hǎokàn: This movie is good.
cards.Notes: 好 good + 看 to look at = nice to watch

cards.Example: 我在机场等你。 wǒ zài jīchǎng děng nǐ: I'll wait for you at the airport.
cards.Notes: 机 machine (plane) + 场 field, ground (土 + sound) = airfield

cards.Example: 老人走得很慢。 lǎorén zǒu de hěn màn: The old man walks slowly.
cards.Notes: 老 old + 人 person

cards.Example: 他是工人。 tā shì gōngrén: He's a worker.
cards.Notes: 工 work + 人 person

cards.Example: 你在家吗? nǐ zài jiā ma: Are you home?
cards.Notes: 在 at + 家 home

cards.Example: 这个很好吃! zhège hěn hǎochī: This is delicious!
cards.Notes: 好 good + 吃 to eat = good to eat

cards.Example: 老师再见! lǎoshī zàijiàn: Goodbye, teacher!
cards.Notes: 再 again + 见 see = see you again

cards.Example: 我常常想你。 wǒ chángcháng xiǎng nǐ: I often think of you.
cards.Notes: 常 often, doubled for emphasis

cards.Example: 我们班男生很多。 wǒmen bān nánshēng hěn duō: Our class has lots of boys.
cards.Notes: 男 male + 生 student = boy, guy
